sources.title: RG of GR from on-shell amplitudes

evidence.text: Extract anomalous dimensions from Lorentz-invariant phase-space integrals of products of tree amplitudes across two-particle cuts. Project onto the rational bubble contribution and add collinear terms to account for scaleless bubbles with cancelling UV and IR parts.

sources.title: The EFT bootstrap at finite M$_{PL}$

evidence.text: On-shell reverse unitarity matches products of tree amplitudes onto scalar bubble and box integrals. Integration-by-parts identities, implemented with LiteRed, remove triangles. General-dimensional matching also determines rational terms; EFT-only, mixed, and pure-gravity contributions are separated.

sources.title: Negative running of gravitational positivity

evidence.text: Enumerate relevant three- and four-point on-shell amplitudes using naive dimensional analysis, factorisation and helicity selection. Extract one-loop beta-functions from UV-divergent Passarino–Veltman bubbles using two-particle unitarity cuts, subtracting triangle and box contributions where necessary.

sources.title: RG of GR from on-shell amplitudes

evidence.text: Implement the rational-part projection through a spinor parameterization of two-body phase space, contour residues and Hermite polynomial reduction, extracting rational primitives without computing logarithmic terms.

sources.title: RG of GR from on-shell amplitudes

evidence.text: Use little-group scaling, factorization and modified-helicity addition to constrain amplitudes. Supersymmetric Ward identities supply vanishing-amplitude proofs; angular-momentum decompositions further restrict cuts and stress-tensor renormalization.

sources.title: The EFT bootstrap at finite M$_{PL}$

evidence.text: Fixed-t and crossing-symmetric contour dispersion relations equate calculable IR arcs to UV partial-wave integrals. Smearing must make the IR integrals finite and the UV integrals positive. The crossing-symmetric slicing holds p²=2stu/(s²+t²+u²)>0 fixed.

sources.title: Completeness from gravitational scattering

evidence.text: A fixed-t analytic dispersion relation expresses the low-energy coefficient c2(t) as s- and u-channel contributions when b2(t)=0. The universal graviton pole contributes −8πGN/t, ensuring a nonzero coefficient near the forward limit and hence at least one exchanged state.

sources.title: The Equivalence Principle at High Energies Completes the Spectrum

evidence.text: Decomposes the charge-space identity into irreducible-representation projectors in each fusion channel. Fixed-t contour dispersion relations then relate the graviton pole to weighted sums of massive s- and u-channel residues; missing representations are excluded by contradiction.

sources.title: Half-Completeness from Standard Gravitational Dispersion Relations

evidence.text: Use low-energy crossing null constraints with spin-polynomial weights nonnegative on Bose-allowed spins. Special nulls remove four exceptional lower-isospin omissions. A residue-theorem construction supplies an infinite hierarchy of nulls whose first p allowed spins have zero weight and higher spins positive weight.

sources.title: Completeness from gravitational scattering

evidence.text: The constructive algorithm alternates elastic scattering with symmetry operations. Weyl reflections, allowed outer automorphisms and imported weight-string relations generate further weights; recursively enlarged polytopes and induction establish coverage of charge sectors.

sources.title: The Equivalence Principle at High Energies Completes the Spectrum

evidence.text: Constructs an auxiliary odd-residue sum using an imaginary-axis integral of the crossing-odd amplitude after subtracting its linear term. For democracy, replaces high-energy pole towers by Regge discontinuities and compares energy-averaged residues with the identity tensor.

sources.title: Half-Completeness from Standard Gravitational Dispersion Relations

evidence.text: Construct an explicit amplitude from symmetrized Gamma-function blocks. For the Euler-class obstruction, express every massive residue as an endpoint Taylor coefficient and use independence of distinct exponentials over polynomials to force each block into the allowed tensor subspaces of both channels.

evidence.text: At each temperature, fit E/N²≈e00+e01/L+e02/L²+e10/N² simultaneously in lattice extent and matrix size. Here e00 is the continuum, large-N energy and e10 its leading continuum finite-N correction. Sequential extrapolation provides a reported compatibility check.

evidence.text: Discretize Euclidean time and sample configurations with rational hybrid Monte Carlo. Internal energy is measured through the bosonic action.
